title: finding(app-shell,i18n): the dashboard add-widget picker and the widget-type catalogue render English under zh-CN (AddWidgetPicker, widget-types.ts)
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with named sites. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the `domain:ui` execution seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat #2 (`session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`) from the dev report on objectui#10748 (`5857433868`, `out_of_scope_findings` 3). The report names no carrier, and none exists. The seat read the sites at source on objectui `origin/main`; nothing was run.

## The sites

Under zh-CN, clicking 添加组件 in `DashboardDefaultInspector` (itself translated) opens a popover whose words are English. `DashboardPreview` has the same picker. The literals:
- `previews/AddWidgetPicker.tsx`: the search placeholder "Search widgets…";
- `previews/widget-types.ts`: `WIDGET_CATEGORY_LABEL` ("Single value", "Charts", "Tabular") and `WIDGET_TYPE_META[].label` ("Metric (KPI)" … "Pivot table").

## A reader split to settle first

`WIDGET_TYPE_META[].label` also feeds `DashboardDefaultInspector`'s `New TYPE` default title for a new widget. That title is author data, the stored widget title, and it is on objectui#10678 / #10651's 「left literal on purpose」 list. So keying the catalogue label means splitting that reader:
- the picker shows a localized label;
- the default title keeps writing today's English, or is re-ruled.
Say which in the PR.

## Direction (for triage to confirm or re-route)

The objectui#10748 shape:
- `engine.*` rows (en equal to the current literal, plus zh). For chart names, use the terms `packages/i18n`'s `widgetType` rows already use (柱状图, 折线图 …);
- pin the picker under zh, with an en control;
- the stored `type` does not move.
